title: EO: An Entrancing Tale of a Wandering Donkey

commenti.body:
I haven't seen the film yet but I'm planning to very soon, as I hope to compare/contrast it with Bresson's ***Au Hasard Baltazar***, which by all accounts it is based on. So I can't comment on the content of your review from knowledge of the film.

Your review is certainly well-written, as I would judge such things. That is, it expresses a point of view clearly and in a way that is structured and thoughtful. I'm guessing English may not be your native language and so there are a couple of grammar errors, but nothing too significant (eg "whose" not "that's" in the 1st line 2nd paragraph). 

I would certainly encourage you to keep writing longer-form reviews and essays if you wish to, and if you'd like help in correcting those few tiny issues I'd be very happy to look them over and suggest corrections. But as I said, these really are secondary issues, the key thing being a clear point of view and an opinion the reader can feel is justified.
